notes:
Summary: Boreal Sentry builds a cloud contact-center stack used by retail + telco customers. Primary ask = real-time agent assist: streaming suggestions inserted into agent UI, ticket summarization after call, and safe tool-calling to update Zendesk/SFDC. Requirements: p95 suggestion latency target <= 250ms for US regions, jitter < 30ms, ability to sustain 150 concurrent agents per region with bursts to 1200 during campaigns (holiday prep). They care about fallbacks: when dedicated pool saturates, fallback to lower-cost hosted model with degraded SLOs.

Security & compliance: must pass SOC2 plus SSO/SAML integration; EU customers require data residency and retention controls (30/90 day retention windows). They asked for KMS/HSM support and immutable audit logs for function calls. Also want token-level cost breakdown in console.

Technical notes (SE): prefer open-model variants with quantization-friendly paths; interested in 8-bit int quantization + KV cache to reduce per-token cost. Want function-calling guardrails: only allow a small set of sanctioned API calls (ticket.update, macro.run, escalate.create). Need hallucination mitigation for tool-calls (pre-check layer + human-in-the-loop approval for high-risk commands). POC acceptance criteria: p95 streaming latency < 260ms, suggestion relevance > 82% on seed prompt set, zero unauthorized tool invocations during test.

Quotes: CTO "We cannot accept >300ms latency for suggestions — it breaks agent flow." AE-observation: agent feedback liked quick completions but flagged hallucination risk on account numbers. Next steps: finalize infra blueprint, price for dedicated 4x A100 equiv, run 7-day streaming load test with synthetic spikes, legal to confirm DPA addendum and egress rules.
